Subject: Redwood trial — procurement & billing readiness / next steps

Hi Olivia / Tom —

Great to meet today — thanks for walking through the pilot goals and success criteria. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement has what they need to evaluate the commercial path.

Summary of the pilot we discussed:
- Goal: validate integration of Redwood inference into Acme’s customer support routing (NLP reranking + embeddings).
- Duration: 4 weeks pilot (configurable) with a small dedicated capacity slice.
- Success criteria (proposed):
  - Technical: 95th percentile gen latency <250ms on typical 512-token prompts; identical prompt accuracy measured by internal eval >85% acceptance rate on our labeled prompt set.
  - Usage threshold for conversion: sustained usage averaging >=100k tokens/day for 7 consecutive days OR clear product KPIs showing >20% lift in routing accuracy (your metric).

Commercial/procurement questions for your team:
1) Payment path: do you prefer to purchase on a card (fast path) or via Purchase Order (standard PO/SOW path)?
2) If PO path, please confirm procurement contact and any required vendor forms or W-9s; we can provide vendor info and a short SOW.
3) Marketplace: are you interested in buying via AWS Marketplace/Azure Marketplace? If so we’ll surface the listing and provide marketplace pricing terms.
4) Billing start: do you want billing to start on the first day of the pilot (card charge), or only once a PO is effective? Both are possible — I’ve outlined operational tradeoffs below.

Proposed commercial paths:
- Fast path (recommended for short pilots): Card on file for month-0 trial, billing starts when tokens are consumed; conversion to PO later if procurement needs. This removes the 3–6 week PO delay.
- Procurement-first path: Redwood provides SOW + vendor form; billing starts on the PO effective date. Typical PO timeline is 2–6 weeks depending on your internal cycle.

I’ve attached a draft SOW and a vendor info packet to speed procurement review. Next steps I propose:
- You: confirm preferred payment path and procurement contact (procurement@acmeinc.com is fine if that’s the right inbox).
- Us (Redwood): if PO path, we’ll send a completed vendor packet + SOW for signature (DocuSign link). If card path, we’ll provision trial access and set a billing start date once you confirm.

Let me know which path you’d like to follow and we’ll move the right docs.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Thanks, Marissa — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few notes from our side:

- Procurement preference: Acme prefers PO for any vendor spend >$10k. For smaller pilot spend we can sometimes do a card, but procurement will still need the vendor form and W-9 to create a vendor record.
- Timeline: If we go the PO route, expect ~3–5 weeks for internal approvals (could be faster depending on SOW clarity). Card path would let us start within days.
- Marketplace: yes, we prefer to purchase through AWS Marketplace when available (it simplifies our procurement and billing). Do you have an AWS Marketplace listing/ASIN we can reference?
- Contacts: procurement@acmeinc.com is correct for vendor forms. Tom (cc’d) will be our technical owner and will validate success criteria.

Action for Redwood: please share the vendor packet (vendor form + W-9) and a final SOW. If you can provide marketplace listing info that would be helpful.

—Olivia

Thanks all — appreciate the clarity. Quick plan to keep momentum:

1) Two commercial paths (pick one):
   - Fast path (recommended to start): Card on file for month-0 to avoid PO delay. Billing starts when trial usage begins (we’ll only charge card for actual usage). We’ll collect vendor form + W-9 in parallel so you can convert to PO once procurement completes.
   - Procurement-first path: Redwood will issue SOW + vendor info; billing will begin on the PO effective date. Expect ~3–5 week procurement timeline.

2) What Redwood will provide today (attached & links):
   - Attached: SOW_v1.pdf (draft), redwood_trial_agreement.pdf (trial terms).
   - Vendor packet: vendor_form_acme.pdf (please return completed).
   - Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace (we’ll share the listing ASIN and consolidated invoice option).
   - DocuSign SOW link: https://www.docusign.com/rcp/envelope-status/12345

3) Proposed success criteria (finalizable with Tom):
   - Technical: P95 latency <250ms on 512-token prompts; no more than 1% error rate on the integration calls.
   - Business: sustained usage >=100k tokens/day for 7 consecutive days OR measurable KPI lift (eg, >=20% improvement in routing accuracy).

4) Billing start recommendation: For speed, start billing on first day of pilot (card) and switch to PO as soon as procurement completes. If Acme requires PO-only, we can set an official billing start date equal to the PO effective date. Please tell us your preference and an expected PO target date if choosing procurement-first.

5) Next steps / owners:
   - Olivia/Tom: confirm payment path (card vs PO) and, if PO, estimated PO date. (owner: Olivia)
   - Procurement: provide any special vendor form fields or additional compliance docs needed. (owner: procurement@acmeinc.com)
   - Redwood: finalize SOW and send DocuSign link; provide AWS Marketplace ASIN and vendor tax info. (owner: Marissa / Aditya)

If you’d like, we can schedule a 20-min call with procurement + legal to walk the SOW and vendor packet this week.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once I have your preference.
